text: It is all a matter of time scale. An event that would be unthinkable in a hundred years may be inevitable in a hundred million.
author: Carl Sagan
visual_brief: A precise geological cross-section in clean orthographic line work, depicting horizontal sediment strata interrupted by a single micro-fault and a slow glacial U-valley. Fine engineering dimension lines, depth indicators, and subtle directional shear arrows frame the layers, emphasizing imperceptible movement across immense scales.
alt: Orthographic geological cross-section of ancient rock strata with engineering dimension lines
